information.description:
When unnamed faces are needed to protect top-level black sites, those who get hired are usually of a much higher caliber than your typical bodyguard. When this hired gun also wears reinforced armor, installs extra cyberware, and totes heavy firepower, they become a true menace that can fend off large-scale opposition almost single-handedly.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Generics).

Smart Glasses with pre-installed Image Enhance, which does not consume any Option Slots and cannot be removed. Unlike regular Smart Glasses, these cannot be modified to use an alternate frame or style, and obscure the user’s eyes from external view.
